title: Food Safety and Agro-Processing Act
authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Food Systems
summary: Sets the food-safety, traceability, inspection, and processing requirements for food businesses and agro-processors.
applicability: Agro-processors, food manufacturers, farms supplying processed food

rules.outcome: Require Food Processing Permit before commercial production
rules.explanation: Food-processing facilities must hold a permit before production begins.

rules.outcome: Require food-safety inspection certificate every 12 months
rules.explanation: Annual inspection evidence is required for an active operating profile.

rules.outcome: Require batch and supplier traceability records
rules.explanation: Food batches must be traceable to suppliers and customers.

rules.outcome: Apply simplified record-keeping route
rules.explanation: This draft exception requires legal review before publication.

title: Mining Rights and Mineral Beneficiation Regulations
summary: Defines mining-rights, reporting, rehabilitation, local procurement, and mineral-beneficiation requirements.
applicability: Mining companies, mine operators, mineral processors

rules.outcome: Submit quarterly production and rehabilitation report
rules.explanation: Operating mine sites must submit production and rehabilitation information quarterly.

rules.outcome: Require beneficiation and local-value plan
rules.explanation: Large mineral output triggers a local beneficiation plan.

rules.outcome: Route submissions to Northern Minerals Office
rules.explanation: The Northern Minerals Office is the designated submission authority.

title: Small Business Growth and Market Access Policy
summary: Expands access to procurement, finance, training, and market opportunities for small and emerging businesses.
applicability: SMEs, sole proprietors, cooperatives, manufacturers, retailers

rules.outcome: Eligible for SME market-access programme
rules.explanation: Businesses meeting the SME definition may apply for market-access support.

rules.outcome: Recommend procurement-readiness assessment
rules.explanation: Verified operating profiles can be referred to procurement-readiness support.

title: Electricity Generation Incentive Gazette
summary: Publishes the current incentive window for new generation capacity and grid-support projects.

rules.outcome: Eligible to submit generation incentive application
rules.explanation: Projects meeting the capacity and grid-connection threshold may apply during the incentive window.

title: Retail and Consumer Protection Operating Guideline
summary: Provides practical guidance for transparent pricing, returns, product information, and customer complaints.
applicability: Retail stores, wholesalers, e-commerce and distribution businesses

rules.outcome: Recommend published returns and complaints process
rules.explanation: This is guidance and should not be treated as an automatic enforcement rule.

rules.outcome: Recommend clear price and product information
rules.explanation: The guideline supports consistent customer-facing product information.

title: Constituency Development Fund Implementation Policy
authority: Ministry of Local Government and Community Development
summary: Provides the framework for planning, submitting, approving, procuring, and monitoring community development projects funded through CDF.
applicability: Government agencies, municipalities, contractors, SMEs, community organizations

rules.outcome: Eligible for CDF project funding assessment
rules.explanation: A project must be a documented community priority with an approved implementation plan.

rules.outcome: Require quarterly progress, expenditure, and community-benefit report
rules.explanation: Active CDF projects must report delivery and expenditure each quarter.

title: Public Finance Management Act
summary: Defines controls for public funds, budgeting, expenditure, financial reporting, accountability, and oversight.
applicability: Government ministries, agencies, municipalities, public entities, suppliers of public institutions

rules.outcome: Require approved budget allocation before commitment
rules.explanation: Public expenditure must be supported by an approved budget allocation.

rules.outcome: Require quarterly financial performance report
rules.explanation: Public institutions must report financial performance using the prescribed cycle.

rules.outcome: Escalate commitment for higher approval
rules.explanation: Commitments above delegated authority limits require escalation.

title: Public Procurement and Disposal Regulations
summary: Sets public procurement planning, tendering, evaluation, supplier registration, contract award, and disposal controls.
applicability: Public procuring entities, suppliers, contractors, SMEs, manufacturers, service providers

rules.outcome: Supplier may participate in public tender
rules.explanation: Active registration and tax compliance are required for tender participation.

rules.outcome: Require open competitive procurement route
rules.explanation: Procurements at or above the threshold require open competition.

rules.outcome: Require verified local SME ownership and operating profile
rules.explanation: Reserved tenders require evidence of local SME eligibility.

title: Tax Incentives and Investment Allowances Framework
authority: Revenue Authority and Investment Promotion Agency
summary: Catalogues investment allowances, export incentives, agro-processing benefits, manufacturing deductions, and qualifying employment incentives.
applicability: Manufacturers, agro-processors, exporters, investors, technology companies, SMEs

rules.outcome: Recommend investment allowance application
rules.explanation: New productive assets above the threshold may qualify for an investment allowance.

rules.outcome: Eligible for export-support incentive screening
rules.explanation: Compliant exporters may be screened for the applicable export incentive.

rules.outcome: Recommend agro-processing tax incentive assessment
rules.explanation: Agro-processors meeting the local value-added threshold may qualify for assessment.

title: Local Content and Supplier Development Regulations
summary: Strengthens participation of local businesses, workers, manufacturers, suppliers, and service providers in public and private value chains.
applicability: Mining companies, energy producers, manufacturers, infrastructure contractors, agro-processors, public procuring entities

rules.outcome: Require local supplier participation plan before award
rules.explanation: Covered projects above the threshold must demonstrate how local suppliers will participate.

rules.outcome: Qualify supplier for local-content scoring category
rules.explanation: Entities meeting the local ownership threshold qualify for local-content scoring.

rules.outcome: Require local skills, apprenticeship, and workforce development plan
rules.explanation: Covered projects must show how local skills and employment will be developed.

rules.outcome: Require quarterly local-content performance report
rules.explanation: Operators must report local supplier spend, workforce participation, and development outcomes quarterly.

title: Local Manufacturing and Value Addition Policy
summary: Promotes local production, domestic value addition, supplier development, and market access for locally manufactured goods.
applicability: Manufacturers, agro-processors, shoe makers, furniture makers, clothing businesses, retailers

rules.outcome: Recommend local manufacturing support and market-access assessment
rules.explanation: Businesses meeting the local value-added threshold can be referred to support programmes.

rules.condition: product.isLocallyManufactured = true AND actor.verification = Verified operational profile
rules.outcome: Eligible for local-products marketplace and buyer-matching service
rules.explanation: Verified local producers may be referred to the approved buyer-matching service.
